name: Isolated Tool and Code Sandbox
mechanism: Executes generated code and high-risk tools in a disposable tenant-scoped environment with bounded resources, explicit mounts, no inherited secrets and deny-by-default egress.
use_when: Agents execute generated code or untrusted parsers
Tenant workloads require a containment boundary from host and peers
avoid_when: All operations are schema-bound remote APIs with no local execution
The sandbox configuration exposes host sockets broad mounts or ambient credentials
expected_effects: Reduced blast radius for code execution and parser compromise
failure_modes: Writable host mounts or container socket defeat isolation
Shared credentials or caches cross tenant boundaries
Unrestricted egress enables exfiltration or command-and-control
